name: texthyper
title: Texthyper
description: Save pages to Texthyper, search your library and highlights, and pick what to read next.
author: marckohlbrugge

commands.name: save
commands.title: Save to Texthyper
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Saves the URL you type, else the page in your browser (as you see it, paywalls included), else a link you selected or copied.

preferences.name: sendPageContent
preferences.title: Browser Tabs
preferences.label: Send the page as the browser shows it
preferences.description: With Raycast's browser extension, the page's HTML goes along with the URL, so paywalled and logged-in pages are saved as you see them. Off, Texthyper fetches the URL itself.

commands.name: library
commands.title: Search Library
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Browse your unread, liked and archived articles, folders and tags, and search the full text of everything you saved.

commands.name: highlights
commands.title: Search Highlights
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Search every passage you highlighted and every note you wrote, then copy, paste or share it.

commands.name: read-next
commands.title: Read Next
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Opens something to read that fits the minutes you have, the article you were in the middle of first.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Unread in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Shows your unread count in the menu bar, with what you were reading and what you saved last.

preferences.name: showCount
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.label: Show the unread count next to the icon
preferences.description: Off, only the icon shows in the menu bar.

commands.name: account
commands.title: Texthyper Account
commands.subtitle: Texthyper
commands.description: Sign in with your email address and a six-digit code, see your counts, or sign out.

tools.name: search-articles
tools.title: Search Articles
tools.description: Full-text search over everything saved in Texthyper, the archive included.

tools.name: list-articles
tools.title: List Articles
tools.description: The saved articles, newest first: unread, liked, archived or all, optionally by tag.

tools.name: read-article
tools.title: Read Article
tools.description: One saved article's text as Markdown, with its highlights and notes.

tools.name: save-article
tools.title: Save Article
tools.description: Saves a web page to the Texthyper library.

tools.name: list-highlights
tools.title: List Highlights
tools.description: Highlighted passages and their notes, from one article or the whole library.

ai.instructions: Texthyper is the user's read-later library: articles they saved from the web, the passages they highlighted and the notes they wrote. Use search-articles to find articles by topic and read-article for the text before summarizing or quoting one. Use list-highlights when the user asks what they highlighted or noted. Every article has an app_url that opens it in Texthyper; link it when you mention one. Nothing here deletes or archives.

preferences.name: openIn
preferences.title: Open Articles
preferences.description: What Enter does on an article in Search Library.

preferences.name: server
preferences.title: Server
preferences.description: Only for a Texthyper server of your own. Leave empty for texthyper.com.
